name: odoo-ops
description: Operational runbooks for Ordomatics infrastructure. Use when the user needs to wipe and redeploy a K8s environment, sync an ArgoCD application, or recover from a Supabase circuit breaker error. Trigger phrases: 'reset the dev environment', 'wipe and redeploy', 'ArgoCD isn't picking up my commit', 'circuit breaker is open', 'too many authentication errors'.
